description: [Act · writes] Append an entry to the outreach log for a Constellation campaign. Use to record connection requests, acceptances, replies, or no-responses so get_campaign_stats can compute acceptance / reply rates over time. Identify the person with exactly one of person_id or linkedin_url (any profile URL form works: vanity or member-ID, with or without trailing slash or query string). The person must be connected to you: in one of your campaigns or segments, engaged with posts you can see in Flux, or pulled by you; anyone else returns not-found with a next_step to pull their profile via linkedin_profile_info. The person may be outside this campaign's mapped constellation; such outcomes are still logged (with a `warning`) and get_campaign_stats reports them under the `unattributed` pool/tier bucket. Free — costs 0 credits.

action.description: Outreach event: sent_request | accepted | replied | no_response

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the person you outreached to. Provide this or person_id.

person_id.description: people.id of the person you outreached to. Provide this or linkedin_url.
